title: mine evidence to extend LEET for France
headline: LEET is complete and correct for the 18 genuine French leetspeak token types (2253 occurrences) but actively CORRUPTS the 5 French ordinal/etage abbreviation types (3eme, 1er, 3e, 1ere, 7eme = 1111 occurrences) into non-words. No new LEET digit keys are warranted; an ordinal guard plus a NAME_CANON ordinal dictionary is the fix. Separately, a clean NEGATIVE: the s2/s3 department gap is NOT supported for the top-3 department tokens - nord, gironde and loire atlantique are all already FR_REGIONS keys.

most_important_number.meaning: French name-token occurrences that LEET actively corrupts into non-words (20.93% of the 5307 mixed-digit France name tokens)

leet_semantics_pinned.applies_to: NAME tokens only, and only when a token contains both a letter and a digit
leet_semantics_pinned.not_applied_to: normalize_address (line 342-349) - address tokens go straight to canon.get(t,t)
leet_semantics_pinned.order: t.translate(LEET) THEN NAME_CANON.get(t,t); NAME_STOP applied after

addr_column_mixed_tokens.verdict: DO NOT extend LEET to the address path; extend ADDR_CANON_FR instead
addr_column_mixed_tokens.note: unlike names, French ADDRESS mixed tokens DO use digits 2 and 9 (2b 237, 2bis 196, 9b 166, 2eme 697, cour2 3872)

absent; inflated by accent split, see profile_defect

region_state_tables.multi_word_key_caveat: 6 keys are multi-word and can NEVER appear as a single profile token; a count of 0 for them is a tokenisation artefact, not evidence of absence
region_state_tables.discriminator: token is an s2/s3-only geographic label iff rate_s1 < 0.5% and (rate_s2 >= 2% or rate_s3 >= 2%)

class_a_complete.in_fr_regions: part of key pas de calais

region_state_tables.clean_negative: NO high-mass currently-unhandled department token exists. The three tokens carrying the s2/s3 department encoding (nord, gironde, loire atlantique) are ALL already FR_REGIONS keys. already_checked offers exactly these three as examples of the gap; on the profile they are examples of the opposite.

state_resolution_upper_bound.criterion: a France row can only resolve state if its address contains a token that is the distinctive proxy of one of the 14 FR_REGIONS keys; summing those proxy counts is a valid upper bound because a row matching k keys is counted k times, so sum >= union
state_resolution_upper_bound.interpretation: corroborates the ~70% band and contradicts D077's 97.44% under an independently stated criterion. Does NOT settle the D073/D077 dispute.

actionable.note: these rows are unreachable by ANY FR_REGIONS extension because the string is not in the data - the gap is a missing field, not a thin dictionary

profile_defect_found.source: build_profile.py:28 TOKEN_RE = [a-z0-9]+ applied at :111 and :127 to the raw lowercased string
profile_defect_found.mechanism: [a-z0-9] does not match e-acute, so every accented French word is chopped at its first accent
profile_defect_found.contrast: _upstream/src/normalize.py:264-266 strip_accents (NFKD) DOES rejoin these, so the pipeline sees one token where the profile shows two
profile_defect_found.consequence: all counts involving accented French candidates are floors and may be split across tokens; the single biggest reason to re-measure against raw data before editing ADDR_CANON_FR

gaps: @ and $ LEET keys are UNTESTABLE: build_profile.py TOKEN_RE [a-z0-9]+ discards every non-alphanumeric character, so the profile contains no symbol-leetspeak information
~9-10% of French name-token mass lies outside the top-4000 cut, so additional mixed-token types may exist
no co-occurrence data: addr_tokens flattens all comma-components into one counter (build_profile.py:126-127), so every state-resolution figure here is a union bound, not a direct count
ge (41120) unresolved - could not determine what it abbreviates

recommendations.action: Add a French-ordinal regex guard (^\d+(er|ere|e|eme|ieme)$) BEFORE translate(LEET) in _name_tokens
recommendations.effect: diverts 1111 occurrences (20.93% of French mixed name tokens) out of garbage tokens
aligns 1111 leet-mangled occurrences with 460+ already-written plain forms (troisieme 218, premier 128, premiere 114, deuxieme 102, cinquieme 9)
unifies 9403 occurrences currently split across cour/cours/crs

recommendations.action: DO NOT add any digit key to LEET
recommendations.effect: none - 0 of 5307 French mixed name occurrences use digit 2 or 9. Deliberate no-change recommendation.

recommendations.action: DO NOT apply LEET in normalize_address
recommendations.effect: 59.64% of French mixed address tokens would change and every change is a corruption

recommendations.action: Re-measure the ADDR_CANON_FR candidate table against raw data before editing
recommendations.effect: the profile's missing accent stripping makes esplanade/chaussee/cite/ge counts unreliable

recommendations.action: Stop sizing fixes from the 71.10/97.44 dispute; independent union bound is 69.41% and the residual ~30% has no region token in the data at all
recommendations.effect: prevents a dictionary fix being sized against an unreachable population

not_rederived: REFUTED-1 France postcode loss (dig5 France test_s1 = 1082 / 259452 = 0.417% of rows)
the missing FR_REGIONS self-map loop at normalize.py:252 - zero measurable effect, all 14 canonical values occur 0 times as input tokens

name_address_leet_asymmetry.finding: LEET is applied ONLY to business_name (_name_tokens, normalize.py:280) and NEVER to business_address (normalize_address, normalize.py:328-352). A repo-wide search for 'LEET|translate' returns exactly two hits, both inside _name_tokens.
name_address_leet_asymmetry.combined_arithmetic: 879 (name, corrupted) + 2313 (address, preserved) = 3192 occurrences of the same two literals forced into two output spaces by field alone

why_it_costs_a_match.blocking: keys.py:33-34 builds nt from ncore (LEET-processed); keys.py:39-43 builds alph from atoks (RAW). The kind-0 NA key at keys.py:60 is an XOR of a name-token hash and an address-token hash, so it needs both sides to agree on a string. 'eeme' != '3eme' so the key cannot form.
why_it_costs_a_match.features: features.py:128-129 computes wn and wa against SEPARATE idf tables (name_idf, addr_idf), so a corrupted name token cannot be rescued by the address column.

name_address_leet_asymmetry.reverification: All F2/F3 figures recomputed independently from analysis_out/profile/test_s{1,2,3}.json: 2253 + 1111 + 1943 = 5307 confirmed; 13580 confirmed.

corrections_on_reverification: REMOVED an earlier assertion of '~10% of address-token mass' is not visible. It is NOT computable: by_country stores name_tokens (a true token total) but no address-token total. Only addr_chars/addr_empty/num_digits/dig5/dig6/alpha_only_addr/has_comma/len_hist exist. Replaced with an explicit gap rather than restated.

RETAINED and independently reproduced: 2253 / 1111 / 1943 = 5307 (name), 13580 (address), 1,111 ordinal corruption, nord/gironde/atlantique already FR_REGIONS keys, cour=9403, esplanade=878, chaussee=1125, cite=2546, ge=41120.
